reports.notes: Handwritten all-caps cover, cursive summary. Lines 1 and 2 carry a leading '$' (dropped per the schema) and Column A is written as a bare '500' with no cents, while lines 4-6 write the same figure as '500.00'; both forms are transcribed exactly as printed. Line 3 is a plain handwritten '0' and line 7 is a struck-through '0' (the filer's slashed-zero) - both transcribed as 0 at medium confidence. The 'Is this report an amendment?' Yes and No boxes are BOTH unchecked - is_amendment is '' (blank, not 'No'). Only ONE report-type box is checked here ('Seven days preceding the General Election'), unlike this filer's June report (key 42f72d3a) where two were marked. Office Seeking reads 'UTAH COUNTY RECORDER', agreeing with index.csv. The Page/of box on the summary page was left blank; Last Name (Smith) and Date of Report (10/25/2010) are filled. Note the year-to-date 4677.47 = the June report's 4177.47 plus this period's 500, so the two filings chain consistently.

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($500) on the p2 Summary Page, which equals Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($500.00) and is restated at summary line 4 ($500.00) and line 5 ($500.00). ⚠ Schedule A's second printed figure, 'Total Contributions Received', is LEFT BLANK by the filer — the page subtotal and the cover are the two anchors that exist, and they agree.
contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row is 500.00 and equals the schedule's printed page subtotal AND the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 4,677.47 and is NOT summed as an increment; it is exactly this period's 500.00 plus the 4,177.47 this filer reported in June, i.e. the cumulative column behaving as the promotion regime describes. The balance ladder closes: 0 (line 3, a written zero glyph) + 500.00 (line 4) = 500.00 (line 5); 500.00 - 500.00 (line 6) = a struck zero glyph at line 7.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($500) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's CORRECTED 'Subtotal for this page' ($500.00, written above a struck-out earlier figure) and to its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' ($500.00), and restated at summary line 6 ($500.00)
expenditures.detail: 4 Schedule B rows sum to 100.00 + 100.00 + 50.00 + 250.00 = 500.00 exactly = the corrected page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A = line 6. ⚠ THE FILER CORRECTED HIS OWN SUBTOTAL ON THE PAGE AND THE CORRECTION IS THE ONE THAT CLOSES: a 1400 dpi crop shows '$ 250 00' written on the Subtotal line and STRUCK THROUGH with a long diagonal, with '$500 00' written above it. 250.00 is exactly the sum of the first three rows (100 + 100 + 50), so the struck figure is his subtotal BEFORE he added the fourth line, the 8/18/2010 250.00 repayment to himself. Handwritten corrections over struck values govern (per-row rules), the corrected 500.00 is what every other printed figure on the filing agrees with, and the struck 250.00 is retained here rather than discarded. Column B YTD prints 4,677.47 = 4,177.47 + 500.00 and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither Schedule A nor Schedule B on this legacy_colAB blank prints an in-kind column, no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind or 'non-monetary', and the p2 Summary Page carries no separate in-kind line. BOTH conventions were tested rather than inherited: monetary-only gives 500.00 on each side and monetary-plus-in-kind gives the identical 500.00, so both close on Column A. NOTE what the three '(computer help)' rows are NOT: they are cash payments FOR help, entered in the expenditure money column by the filer, not donated services — nothing on the page marks them in-kind and nothing was reclassified.
itemized.escalation_note: Two escalations. (1) A 1400 dpi crop of Schedule B's subtotal cell resolved the filer's own correction: '$ 250 00' struck through with '$500 00' written above it, and 250.00 is exactly the sum of the first three rows, which is what makes the correction legible as an arithmetic revision rather than a misread. (2) A 1000 dpi crop of Schedule B row 1's Name cell resolved the payee's block capitals; the name is transcribed exactly as it renders and no correction was invented. Five further crops at 1000 dpi were geometry proofs, described in the measure_notes.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate name 'JEFFERY DEAN SMITH' (Republican, residence city Orem); index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 listing grouped by office). Page-face Office Seeking reads 'UTAH COUNTY RECORDER' here, where the SAME FILER'S JUNE REPORT writes the abbreviated 'UT. COUNTY RECORDER' — both agree with index.csv's 'County Recorder' and neither was normalised. legacy_colAB, 4 pages, all four read full-page at 200 dpi: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by CONTENT), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B; the cover is handwritten in all-caps block capitals and the summary page in a looser cursive hand. Only ONE report-type box is ticked here, 'Seven days preceding the General Election' — worth noting because this filer's JUNE report ticked TWO boxes at once, so the double-tick was a one-off and not his habit. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED on both his 2010 filings — neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked — which is an honest BLANK and never 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). Signed 10/25/10 and stamped received OCT 25 AM 9:18. FOLIATION: the top-right Page/of box is EMPTY on all three inner sheets while the Last Name and Date of Report cells are filled, exactly as on his June filing. TWO PRINTED FIGURES ARE LEFT BLANK BY THE FILER and are honest blanks rather than gaps in this transcription: Schedule A's 'Total Contributions Received' cell (its page subtotal IS filled, at 500.00) and the p2 foliation. The two sides are again equal to the cent (500.00 each), the same spend-out-to-zero pattern as his June report and as Rodney Campbell's 2010 Recorder filing in this chunk. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this era in the clear, so the donor's post-office box and the vendors' street lines are plainly visible on pp3-4 and were reduced to city/state at READ TIME for the contribution and DROPPED ENTIRELY for the expenditures; none reaches any field or note.
